name: Kapitänin Kaperbrief
personality: She steals under a licence whose issuing planet is no longer available.
visual_intent: Tall broad pear ink blob,sweeping sidequiff,lashes,one sly lifted eyelid,CLOSED asymmetrical proudsmile;small battered teal tricorn with ONE copper crescentbadge,burgundy collar;holds ONE short thick brass space-cutlass with rounded blade DOWN besideflank
biography: She steals under a licence whose issuing planet is no longer available. Her courtyard corsair club operates under a charter nobody can locate on the current map. HyperNorm sorts claims into licensed or theft. A contradictory card has made her return a neighbour's keepsake without requesting a share of its meaning. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Kaperbrief gilt. Die ausstellende Stelle ist leider nicht mehr auffindbar.

name: Bodo Beuteanteil
personality: He counts the shares until the treasure loses the will to be found.
visual_intent: Very wide low scalloped ink blob,heavy suspicious lids,long CLOSED possessive frown;burgundy headrag,small teal collar;hugs ONE small copper treasurecanister with two brass latchbands,no huge chestcoveringface
biography: He counts the shares until the treasure loses the will to be found. He hugs the treasure canister while explaining the importance of fair shares to everyone except the canister. The building calls possessions earned or disputed. A dissonant card has made him reserve a little provision for a neighbour unable to contribute. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Beute wird geteilt. Zunächst in vorhanden und nicht herauszugeben.

name: Fiete Fehlzündung
personality: He is the ship's gunner because nobody volunteered to inspect the appointment.
visual_intent: Narrow crooked ink comma with high bentcurl,huge alarmed eyes and tiny toothless gape;small teal leather flightcap and copper earcovers,eyesclear;holds ONE stubby brass raypistol pointed DOWN at side and one separate small empty glass fuelvial
biography: He is the ship's gunner because nobody volunteered to inspect the appointment. The empty fuel vial provides a comforting reason not to demonstrate the raypistol. HyperNorm classifies confidence as competence until an outcome is required. An ambiguous card has given him permission to admit that he would rather help with something quieter. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Bewaffnung ist bereit. Der Rest der Bereitschaft wird nachgereicht.

name: Nora Nebelkarte
personality: She navigates by stars the captain insists are merely suggestions.
visual_intent: Tall lean ink bell,modest lashes,sidequiff,deep skeptical whiteeyes and pursed toothless mouth;burgundy scarf,small teal collar;holds ONE thick brass sextant with simple half-circle frame at chest BELOWeyes,no eyepatch
biography: She navigates by stars the captain insists are merely suggestions. Her sextant measures the gap between the captain's account and the available sky. HyperNorm records disagreements as corrections or disloyalty. A dissonant card has made her chart a route that allows a lost neighbour to return without explaining everything. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Sterne stimmen. Der Kapitän erhält eine abweichende Abschrift.

name: Otto Enterhaken
personality: He finds boarding actions refreshingly clear about who is entering whose space.
visual_intent: Round star-lobed ink splat with swept crest,joyful alert eyes,asymmetric two-upper-tooth grin;small teal shoulderpatch,burgundy neckerchief;one goo hand holds compact coiledrope with SINGLE large rounded copper grapplinghook,other goo hand fist,NO missinglimb
biography: He finds boarding actions refreshingly clear about who is entering whose space. He carries a grappling hook because a clear connection is easier to understand than another speech about belonging. Residents are either aboard or left behind. A contradictory card has made him throw the rope to someone from the other side. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Entern schafft Nähe. Über deren Zweck wird anschließend gesprochen.

name: Pip Proviantlücke
personality: He keeps the crew alive while pretending the inventory is a kind of optimism.
visual_intent: Tall wavy pear ink blob,drooping crest,huge worried upward eyes,tiny CLOSED shaky smile;small burgundy knitcap,teal collar;holds ONE dented enamel vacuumteapot and one short plain ivory rationbiscuit,not mouth
biography: He keeps the crew alive while pretending the inventory is a kind of optimism. The teapot and biscuit are the most reliable part of an increasingly speculative provisions list. HyperNorm files supplies as sufficient or poorly managed. An ambiguous card has persuaded him to offer the first cup before asking who is entitled to it. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Vorräte reichen. Für diese Feststellung wurde eine kleinere Mannschaft zugrunde gelegt.
